messages:
max: Quick plan for next week's webinar launch: registration page copy, Zoom settings, and post-event delivery. Need owners for recording, captions, and HubSpot gating.

nina: I'll take registration copy + hero CTA. Draft will focus on low-friction reg: name, email, company size (optional), GDPR consent checkbox.

oliver: I'll own Zoom config and recordings. Proposed: host cloud recording + local backups from speaker. Enable auto-transcript for immediate captions.

rachel: For gated enterprise assets, require company size and role. Map 1000+ employee OR title contains "Director"/"VP" -> AE notify. Keep public replay immediate.

videoops-bot: Reminder: enable "Record separate audio files" and "Record shared screen separately" to make clipping easier. Also creating RTMP fallback.

ezra: Postflow: Zoom -> S3 private bucket -> run transcript cleaner -> generate 3 hero clips -> upload to HubSpot. We'll add UTM params to replay links.

max: Timing: 45m content + 15m Q&A. Nina, can you drop reg page draft by EOD? Oliver, please push Zoom settings to staging and share the join link.

nina: Draft in #marketing-drafts by 5pm. Will include a short panelist onboarding paragraph and upload CTA for headshots.

oliver: Staging meeting created, join link posted. I've set passcode and waiting room off for whitelisted panelists.

rachel: I'll build the HubSpot workflow: Day0 replay email, Day2 highlight clip, Day7 demo invite. Enterprise attendees flagged for SDR outreach.

max: Thanks — action owners: nina (reg copy), oliver (zoom + backups), ezra (export pipeline), rachel (HS gating). We'll reconvene after rehearsal. :thumbsup:
